correctness.rationale: Work modulo constants and telescope along steps in x-y, whose jump magnitudes sum to V(x-y). For a step of height t at a cut, a crossing pair (a,b) counted outward from the cut contributes a single response of magnitude at most |t|, present for left occupancy a through m-b inclusive. Under variation sign duality each response is multiplied by the difference of signs at transitions a-1 and m-b. These pairs of transition indices run through exactly the edges of K_m. Thus the total is at most |t| times twice the maximum cut, divided by binom(m,2). An endpoint can only truncate the packet of window increments and cannot increase its variation; n=m gives zero output variation. At a cut after m sites, take x_i=i and add a unit step to get y. Both are strictly increasing, V(x-y)=1, and the full packet is ell(m-ell)/binom(m,2), rising from zero and returning to zero when n≥2m. This attains the bound; the parity simplifications follow directly. The argument proves an envelope for difference kernels, not sharpness for every kernel or for all shorter lengths.
